entities.summary: Robert Patrick Casey Jr. is an American lawyer and politician who served from 2007 to 2025 as a United States senator from Pennsylvania. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Bob Casey was a legal figures from Scranton (b. 1960-04-13, Scranton). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
